name: whisper-dictation
title: Whisper Dictation
description: A powerful dictation tool that uses Whisper for speech-to-text transcription, with AI-powered refinement options.
author: finjo

commands.name: dictate-simple
commands.title: Dictate
commands.subtitle: Whisper Dictation
commands.description: Convert speech to text using Whisper (no AI refinement)

commands.name: dictate
commands.title: Dictate with AI
commands.subtitle: Whisper Dictation
commands.description: Convert speech to text with AI refinement options

commands.name: download-model
commands.title: Download Whisper Model
commands.subtitle: Whisper Dictation
commands.description: Choose and download a model for transcription

commands.name: dictation-history
commands.title: Dictation History
commands.subtitle: Whisper Dictation
commands.description: View, copy, and manage past transcriptions

preferences.name: whisperExecutable
preferences.title: Whisper Executable Path
preferences.description: Path to whisper-cpp main executable. Default assumes Homebrew on Apple Silicon. Check /usr/local/bin/whisper-cli for Intel.

preferences.name: modelPath
preferences.title: Whisper Model Path
preferences.description: Path to your custom Whisper model file (.bin). Handled automatically if model downloaded through extension.

preferences.name: soxExecutablePath
preferences.title: SoX Executable Path
preferences.description: Full path to the 'sox' command-line audio utility. Default assumes Homebrew on Apple Silicon. Check /usr/local/bin/sox for Intel.

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action After Transcription
preferences.description: Action to perform automatically after transcription completes

preferences.name: aiRefinementMethod
preferences.title: AI Refinement Method
preferences.description: Choose which AI service to use for refining transcriptions. OpenAI / Anthropic / OpenRouter use baked-in endpoints — just provide an API key and model name below. Ollama / Custom uses the endpoint you set below (defaults to local Ollama).

preferences.name: promptBeforeDictation
preferences.title: Choose AI prompt before each dictation
preferences.description: When enabled, you'll be asked to select an AI refinement prompt before each dictation session (only when AI refinement is enabled)
preferences.label: Ask for a prompt every time

preferences.name: aiModel
preferences.title: Raycast AI Model
preferences.description: Select which AI model to use for refinement

preferences.name: ollamaEndpoint
preferences.title: Custom API Endpoint
preferences.description: Only used when 'AI Refinement Method' is set to 'Ollama / Custom OpenAI-compatible'. URL of your Ollama server or any OpenAI v1-compatible endpoint. Ignored for OpenAI / Anthropic / OpenRouter (which use built-in endpoints).

preferences.name: ollamaApiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key for the selected AI provider. Required for OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, and any custom endpoint that authenticates. Leave blank if not required (local Ollama).

preferences.name: ollamaModel
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Name of the model to use. Examples: OpenAI → gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o. Anthropic → claude-3-5-haiku-latest, claude-sonnet-4-5. OpenRouter → openai/gpt-4o-mini, anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet, meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct. Ollama → llama3.2:latest.

preferences.name: whisperLanguage
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: ISO 639-1 language code for transcription, or 'auto' to detect. Common codes: en (English), es (Spanish), fr (French), de (German), it (Italian), pt (Portuguese), nl (Dutch), pl (Polish), ru (Russian), zh (Chinese), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), ar (Arabic), hi (Hindi). Forcing the correct language usually beats auto-detect on short clips.

preferences.name: whisperThreads
preferences.title: CPU Threads
preferences.description: Number of CPU threads to pass to whisper-cli (-t). Leave empty to use whisper.cpp's default. Lower this if other apps feel sluggish during transcription, raise it on high-core systems if Whisper isn't saturating your CPU.

preferences.name: whisperInitialPrompt
preferences.title: Initial Prompt
preferences.description: Optional text passed to whisper-cli (--prompt) that biases transcription toward specific vocabulary, punctuation, or style. Different from AI refinement — this is sent to Whisper itself, before transcription. Useful for domain-specific terms (e.g. 'kubectl, podman, GraphQL') or to encourage punctuation/capitalization (e.g. 'Hello, world. This is a sentence.'). Max ~224 tokens.

preferences.name: whisperTranslate
preferences.title: Translate to English
preferences.description: When enabled, Whisper translates the source audio to English instead of transcribing it in the original language. Passes --translate to whisper-cli.
preferences.label: Translate audio to English instead of transcribing

preferences.name: historyLimit
preferences.title: History Size Limit
preferences.description: Maximum number of transcriptions kept in Dictation History. Older entries are dropped when the limit is reached. Set to 0 or leave empty for unlimited (history will grow without bound — use with care).

preferences.name: saveToHistory
preferences.title: Save Dictations to History
preferences.description: When enabled, every transcription is saved to Dictation History. Turn off if you'd rather rely on Raycast's Clipboard History (Pro) for retroactive access and don't want a separate copy of your dictations in this extension's storage. Note that with this off and the default action set to 'None', transcriptions have no record at all.
preferences.label: Keep a dedicated dictation history

preferences.name: waveformWidth
preferences.title: Waveform Width
preferences.description: Width of the recording waveform animation in characters. Pick a preset, or choose 'Custom' to enter an exact value below. Reduce if the animation wraps onto multiple lines (depends on Raycast window mode and text size).

preferences.name: waveformWidthCustom
preferences.title: Custom Waveform Width
preferences.description: Used only when 'Waveform Width' is set to 'Custom'. Enter a positive integer (typical usable range: 30-150). Invalid values fall back to 70.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
